Project: Gaussian HMM Market Regime Filtering | Deliverable 4 FINAL
Research_Question: Does Gaussian HMM regime filtering improve risk-adjusted performance of the original 20/50 SMA and 20-day breakout strategies?
Warmup_Qualification: Strict post-pilot HMM starts after the first 31 observations of 2006, not after a new 90-observation 2006 warm-up; earlier raw prices may enter rolling feature histories.

Numerical_Transition_Prior_Fallback.trigger: All default initializations for a candidate state count fail

Favourable_Regime_Rule: Training-only positive mean gross open-to-open return on eligible long signals, no minimum sample-size constraint
Decision_Timing: Current-day close for regime and strategy signal
DSR: Not reported: no defensible effective independent number of strategy performance-selection trials
PSR_Benchmark: Zero daily Sharpe; skewness/kurtosis approximation, no serial dependence adjustment
Dataset_Calendar_Check: 6,288 expected NYSE sessions, 0 missing and 0 unexpected; 233 legitimate weekday closures
Secondary_Price_Archive_Check: 6,288 OHLC date matches to 2 decimals; third-party archive attributed to Stooq, not directly vendor authenticated
Outlier_Review: 116 flagged |z|>3 using preceding 31 returns, all corroborated to 2 decimal OHLC and assigned historical event review; 0 clipped
Validation: PASS (4,749 predictions / 4,747 holding returns), cost and signal reconciliation
Research_Limitations: 31 training rows for several HMM parameters
Posterior certainty is not classification accuracy
30 vs 31 row ambiguity and 90-row warm-up qualification
Trading frictions only approximate liquidity and costs
